name: quality-limits-policy-v1
purpose: Initial, adjustable process and efficiency limits for the next boundary evaluation run.

tool_errors.rationale: Bound repeated tool-call failures while retaining the existing process checks.

wall_duration_seconds.rationale: Bound wall-clock runtime with a larger initial allowance for compression cases.

measurement_notes: These are adjustable initial thresholds, not validated performance targets.
A network interruption or other availability event must be reviewed separately from capability; preserve original trace and error data.
This policy applies to a future generated suite and does not change the frozen source suite or any completed result.
observation_policy: Diagnostic only: no threshold, no contribution to five-dimensional scores. Missing usage/prices are null, never zero-cost. Cost uses configured rates, not provider invoice.
